design_thesis: One faceted shell tapers continuously bow to stern, its glazing bands reading as a single carved ribbon.

stern.transom_face: faceted glass panel flanked by dark composite fins

superstructure.profile_note: shell tapers aft into low sculpted wing decks

design_identity.hull_material: welded steel hull with vacuum-insulated core
design_identity.superstructure_material: aluminum superstructure with composite fairing panels
design_identity.boot_stripe_colour: narrow gloss black stripe above waterline

form_relationships.governing_line: A single raked sheer line runs unbroken from stem to stern, tying hull and superstructure into one tapered form.
form_relationships.massing_rhythm: The envelope narrows from a broad midship beam toward a compressed bow and a wide raked transom, carved by continuous glazing.
form_relationships.feature_integration: Signature elements emerge as continuations of the hull's structural facets rather than applied fittings.

signature_features.description: Continuous faceted glazing ribbon wraps from bow shoulder to aft quarter
Glass balustrade decks cantilever seamlessly from the superstructure shell
Raked full-beam transom with faceted glass face and fold-down platform

decisions.decision: Retained the 120 m overall length while adjusting beam ratio to 5.2 for a leaner, more continuous silhouette.
Translated sculpted angular lines into a faceted continuous shell rather than separate stacked superstructure blocks.
Distributed principal living spaces across three internal deck zones, unified visually by one uninterrupted glazing band.
Organized four visible tiers around a central atrium void that threads sightlines from bow lounge to aft deck.
Applied matte graphite hull composite paired with warm oak and stone interior surfaces for acoustic mass.
Included a beach club, dive support locker, and convertible aft lounge accessible from the fold-down platform.
Extended signature glazing into a flush recessed ribbon spanning four aperture bands with frameless glass balustrades.
Placed a spa deck with plunge pool and treatment suite within the forward superstructure volume.
Designed the aft main deck lounge with retractable glazing to merge interior and exterior entertaining zones.
Retained six-cabin guest configuration, sized generously for extended cruising and charter comfort.
Integrated commercial-grade automation, water treatment, and multilayer acoustic insulation throughout the hull and shell structure.
